hooks.command: bash -c 'BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot commit directly to main. Create a feature branch first." && exit 1; fi'
bash -c 'echo "BLOCKED: Cannot push directly to main. Use a PR." && exit 1'
bash -c 'echo "GATE: PR merge requested. Requires explicit user approval." && exit 1'
